Movement is ||W_p1 - W_init||, which the reverse triangle inequality bounds BELOW by |delta-of-norms|, so a negative delta is positive evidence that the parameters moved. The driver's own sibling diagnostic uses the absolute form (L1582-1584) and reports `head_untrained_last_layer_static: false` -- though the sibling differs from the gate in TWO respects, absolute-vs-signed AND ON-arm-mean-vs-all-cell-min, so the disagreement is not purely a sign convention (a signed ON-arm mean, +0.004045, would also have passed; red-team hygiene H6). Adjudicated by a TRAINED-MINUS-INIT discrimination index exceeding a margin pre-registered off the random-init distribution, on new seeds -- NOT by an absolute index floor. Null: the trained index sits inside the init head's own distribution, i.e. training adds no discrimination.
hypotheses.basis: 822e measured C1 at 4/5 seeds (mean_median index 1.846) and C2 at 0.0583 (107/1834), both clearing their pre-registered ABSOLUTE bars -- but the run's readiness conjunction voided the verdict, and its Step 7c red team then established that those bars do not separate this leg from H-init-structure. The leg is live and untested as stated here.

hypotheses.label: The discrimination is present but is INIT STRUCTURE, not a trained coupling
hypotheses.desc: The measured cross-candidate spread is what a randomly-initialised first layer plus ReLU already possesses -- exactly the reading the driver's `bias_head_actually_trained` gate text says it exists to exclude, and exactly the one C1/C2 as designed cannot separate from H1. Adjudicated by the same trained-minus-init measurement as H1, of which this leg is the complement: if the trained index does not exceed the init index by the pre-registered margin, this leg holds and H1 does not. Null: the trained index exceeds the init distribution by that margin.
hypotheses.basis: Added at failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-822e_2026-09-05's cross-model Step 7c red team (Finding 2/3) and ratified at its Step 8 gate. Monte-Carlo over 200 trials with a head of the driver's exact shape (K=32 centered random summaries, last-layer norm rescaled to the recorded 0.148, rule_state norm 0.19) gives a RANDOM-INIT raw discrimination index of median 3.93, p5 1.68, p95 5.41, clearing C1's 1.0 floor in 99 percent of trials -- above 822e's measured 1.846, and near the driver's own iid reference of 5.15. The leg is not merely live; on the recorded numbers it is the leg the existing evidence cannot rule out.

hypotheses.label: The propagated bias is candidate-UNIFORM; apparent spread is manufactured by the tanh
hypotheses.desc: The raw pre-tanh bias is a common-mode shift near-identical across candidates; because the output stage is bias_scale*tanh(raw/bias_scale), a uniform raw shift emerges as a non-uniform post-tanh delta of the same order as the observed post-tanh spread. Such a state preserves argmax order and is invisible to every downstream reader. This is the only state that may WEAKEN SD-082. PROBE SKETCH (not assigned to V3-EXQ-822f, which measures a difference of indices and does not separate uniform from discriminating): decompose the raw stage against the post-tanh stage with the tanh scale swept or bypassed, declaring the null as the index sitting near its analytic 0 (< 0.25) in BOTH arms with zero argmax flips.
hypotheses.basis: This is the state the raw-stage DV was constructed to exclude, and it is the driver's own `reads_candidate_uniform` branch. 822e recorded `reads_candidate_uniform: false` and a post-tanh spread (2.15e-3 ON / 2.70e-3 OFF) of exactly the order the driver's header predicts a uniform shift would manufacture, so the leg is not excluded on any adjudicated run.

hypotheses.label: Any index is set upstream: the post-action candidate summaries are too similar to flip hidden units
hypotheses.desc: The index also reads near zero, and can read spuriously high in a pinned-pool arm, when the hidden ReLU mask is IDENTICAL or near-identical across candidates -- an UPSTREAM property of the centered candidate summaries rather than a property of SD-082's consumer. The driver records this caveat at `reads_uniform` and points at the summary-spread statistic. PROBE SKETCH (not assigned to V3-EXQ-822f): decompose the index against per-candidate hidden-mask heterogeneity -- the leg's own adjudication condition, and one 822f performs nowhere.
hypotheses.basis: The `candidate_summary_spread_survives_centering` gate is a FLOOR (worst-cell ratio 2.70e-3 against 1e-3), not a guarantee of mask heterogeneity, and the driver says so in terms. ARM_OFF/seed101 carrying the matrix's highest index (4.316) in a one-rule pinned pool is the kind of observation this leg predicts.

hypotheses.label: The consumer head's capacity caps the achievable discrimination
hypotheses.desc: Over half the head's hidden ReLU units are dead in both arms (`hidden_dead_relu_frac_p2_mean` 0.5140 ON / 0.5127 OFF), so the mapping from rule_state to per-candidate bias runs through roughly half the intended width. On this reading the index is real but systematically depressed, and the pre-registered bars are read against a handicapped head. PROBE SKETCH (not assigned to V3-EXQ-822f): an initialisation or activation-function variation that MOVES the dead fraction, asking whether the index moves with it -- a variation 822f does not perform.
hypotheses.basis: Measured and unchanged across 822c / 822d / 822e, and flagged by the driver itself as `dead_relu_partial_contributor: true` while `dead_relu_confirmed` stays false. Never isolated as a hypothesis; carried as a caveat only.

decision.decision_question: Does the SD-082 TRAINED rule-to-action readout deliver a candidate-discriminating, argmax-consequential action bias BEYOND what the head's initialisation already provides -- the property that makes the SD-078 differentiated rule pool behaviourally consequential rather than silent?
decision.live_gate: V3-EXQ-822f as specified by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-822e_2026-09-05: a TRAINED-MINUS-INIT-HEAD raw discrimination index (the existing `_init_positive_control` snapshot and synthetic probe run through the INIT head as well as the trained one), with the margin pre-registered off the random-init distribution (Monte-Carlo p95 5.41, or an init distribution measured in-run), on NEW seeds (not 101/202/303/404/505), with the trainedness gate re-specified as ||W_p1 - W_init|| per parameter tensor scoped to the treatment arm, and the C4 / SD-078 contrast kept but emitted through the three-valued logic at a seed count its 1.69 variance can support. An ABSOLUTE index floor is explicitly NOT the gate: an untrained head clears 1.0 in 99 percent of trials.
decision.distance_phrase: One DESIGN-CHANGED run away, not one repaired re-run away. The DV, the arm axis and the controls are exercised and stable at full budget, but the load-bearing criterion has to be replaced (init control) and the seeds changed before any run can adjudicate; a same-seed replay is a deterministic re-print of 822d/822e and adjudicates nothing.
decision.observation_bottleneck: TWO, compounding. (1) V3-EXQ-822e's run-level readiness gate `bias_head_actually_trained` compares the SIGNED difference of last-layer weight NORMS (driver L1164-1166) against a 1e-3 LOWER floor over the MINIMUM cell (L1402-1404), so a head that trained inward reads as untrained; ARM_OFF/seed101 read -0.003772 and voided the run, though all ten cells clear the floor on |delta| (min 0.002076). (2) The deeper bottleneck, and the one that survives repairing (1): there is NO INIT-HEAD CONTROL anywhere in the design, so C1 and C2 cannot separate a trained coupling from init structure -- a random-init head of this shape clears C1's floor in 99 percent of Monte-Carlo trials. Until the init control exists this question cannot be adjudicated however well the substrate behaves and however cleanly the readiness gate passes.
